title: And Selector
body:
Two selectors written together with **no space**: matches elements satisfying both at once.

```css
p.box     { ... }   /* p elements that also have class box */
div#first { ... }   /* the div whose id is first */
.box.blue { ... }   /* has both classes */
```

The absence of the space is the whole distinction from a [[Descendant Selector]]. A comma
means the opposite again, "either one" rather than "both". See [[CSS Selectors]].
